record.question: Which of the following is the first country to declare an environment and climate emergency?
record.explanation: Answer D: UK. The UK Parliament declared an environment and climate emergency on 1 May 2019. The wording “first country” is broad because the claim depends on what counts as a country-level declaration; the UK is the intended national-level option. Reference: https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cdp-2019-0104/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
